leadText:
Dan (Japanese: ダン Dan) is a character of the day who appeared in A Sandile Gusher of Change!. He is the first character of the day to appear in .

Dan is a young boy who lives near a Spa Resort, a resort famous for its sand bath. Upon meeting and , he invited them to take a sand bath in their spa resort but suddenly, a group of started digging the sand and made thing worse for the gang. Later on, Dan explained to about the Sandile incident that had been occurring quite often for a few days.

After the Sandile took Ash's Pikachu and into the mountains, Dan tagged along, believing the reason the Sandile were scaring the people away was that the geysers were erupting. Later, it was revealed that the geysers had done more good than harm. They put Dan and his father back in business with a brand-new hot spring, which he treated Ash and Iris to.

He reappeared in flashbacks in Here Comes the Trubbish Squad! and Dancing With the Ducklett Trio!.
